messages:
Priya S.: procurement flagged CloudHarbor POs as UNMATCHED because ack payloads lack invoice_guid. sample below.
Diego M.: is this a recent vendor change or our parser tweak?
marketplace-ops-bot: [automated] 1969999999 - PO_ACK_ERROR - vendor=cloudharbor id=CH-7782 reason=MISSING_INVOICE_GUID
Priya S.: sample ack: ```json
{
  "ack": {
    "po": "PO-4412",
    "status": "ACK"
  }
}
```
Ava L.: CloudHarbor rolled a compact ack mode. they said invoice_guid stays but toggle might be on for some partners.
Diego M.: without invoice_guid we can't auto-link invoices. procurement will hold payments.
Priya S.: 5 customers impacted. procurement wants fix by EOD.
Ava L.: options: (1) ask vendor to re-enable invoice_guid (slow), (2) write enrichment job to call vendor API to fetch GUIDs (faster), (3) parser fallback by matching PO+amount+date (risky).
Diego M.: enrichment job is quickest and safe if we only accept single exact matches. estimate ~3-4h. I'll build it.
marketplace-ops-bot: [automated] support ticket #CH-4312 created for CloudHarbor.
cloudharbor-billing: we can flip invoice_guid flag for Redwood within 12h.
Ava L.: procurement can't wait 12h. Diego, run enrichment for the 5 POs today. I'll push CloudHarbor to prioritize.
Diego M.: creating connector/enrich-missing-guid branch. plan: call GET /vendors/{id}/invoices?po=PO-XXX, match on amount+date, only annotate when single match. run in staging then one-off in prod.
marketplace-ops-bot: [automated] enrichment-job queued: job_id=ej-9001 submitted by diego-m.
Diego M.: staging run OK. prod run in progress. patch is non-destructive (annotates internal records only).
cloudharbor-billing: updated: turned on invoice_guid for redwood-org early; last 3 acks include guid.
Diego M.: prod run finished; 5 POs matched and annotated. procurement cleared 3 payouts, 2 pending settlement. 
Priya S.: procurement asked for monitoring: ack_missing_guid_rate alert when >0.5%/day and vendor onboarding checklist update.
Ava L.: I'll add onboarding item and schedule sync with CloudHarbor.
Diego M.: follow-ups: add parser tolerant matching with opt-in, add enrichment endpoint with rate-limits, add unit + e2e tests. I'll file tickets.
Priya S.: procurement confirms de-escalated. closing thread; reopen if regressions appear.
